plotlines.name: Custody Schedule War
plotlines.summary: Four pilots fight over who gets Ren for calibration, towel-offs, and sleepovers, with a whiteboard schedule that never survives the episode.

plotlines.name: Road Back to Ace
plotlines.summary: Vixen Flight must grind from bottom-tier exhibitions back to ace rank, but they can only field full power when Ren picks who he syncs with.

plotlines.name: Poach Season
plotlines.summary: Rival wings file buyouts, issue duel wagers for Ren's nights, and send honey-trap pilots to lure him into breaking contract.

plotlines.name: Sync Freak Mystery
plotlines.summary: Ren syncs with anyone but burns out fast, and his black-market implant scar suggests someone built him to be shared.

continuity_rules.text: One contract chip covers every Frame restarted in the same duel
Restarting a rival Frame lets that rival owner file a claim in the morning
Carrying a co-pilot for short hops and palm-to-hull contact is legal
Plug suits must stay sealed past the waist or the League fines delays
Holding sync past 80% causes nosebleeds and overheating requiring cooldown
A duel stays live while the protesting wing can still move and shoot
Four Frames can share one co-pilot's sync when linked through an anchor cockpit

overall_plotline.name: Shared Property Contract
overall_plotline.summary: Ren's salvage-law contract makes him the legal property and sole co-pilot of Vixen Flight, forcing four rivalrous women to share his body, schedule, and sync in every duel, bath, and bunk dispute while rivals try to steal him.
